notes: The lease end (Jan 31, 2027), new rent ($1,875) and start date are key facts. The lapse sentence restates the renewal deadline ('by that date') and is not a second item. The inspection is the landlord's work; 'No action is needed from you.' makes it a non-item.

items.title: Sign and return the lease renewal agreement
items.quote: If you wish to renew, please sign and return the enclosed renewal agreement no later than December 1, 2026.
items.note: 0.90. 'no later than' is filler around the date. Page 1. Could be typed decision (renew or not); type is informational.

items.title: Return the parking permit renewal form
items.quote: Please return your parking permit renewal form to the leasing office by November 6.
items.note: 0.90. Month-day with no year, 21 days ahead: this year. Page 2 (after the page break).
